    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public ExprNode Expr => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == CalcKinds.Paren;

    public static ParenExpr Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct NegExpr : ISyntaxView<NegExpr>
{
    public NegExpr(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public ExprNode Expr => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == CalcKinds.Neg;

    public static NegExpr Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct AddExpr : ISyntaxView<AddExpr>
{
    public AddExpr(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public ExprNode Expr1 => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public ExprNode Expr2 => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 2));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == CalcKinds.Add;

    public static AddExpr Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct SubExpr : ISyntaxView<SubExpr>
{
    public SubExpr(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public ExprNode Expr1 => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public ExprNode Expr2 => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 2));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == CalcKinds.Sub;

    public static SubExpr Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public readonly struct MulExpr : ISyntaxView<MulExpr>
{
    public MulExpr(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public ExprNode Expr1 => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 0));

    public ExprNode Expr2 => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 2));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => tree.Kind(index) == CalcKinds.Mul;

    public static MulExpr Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public abstract class CalcVisitor<TResult>
{
    public virtual TResult Visit(SyntaxTree tree, int node)
    {
        int kind = tree.Kind(node);
        if (SyntaxKinds.ModuleOf(kind) == CalcModule.Instance.Id)
        {
            switch (SyntaxKinds.LocalOf(kind))
            {
                case CalcModule.LProgram: return VisitProgram(new ProgramNode(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LAssign: return VisitAssign(new AssignNode(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LExprStatement: return VisitExprStatement(new ExprStatementNode(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LNum: return VisitNum(new NumExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LRef: return VisitRef(new RefExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LCall: return VisitCall(new CallExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LParen: return VisitParen(new ParenExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LNeg: return VisitNeg(new NegExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LAdd: return VisitAdd(new AddExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LSub: return VisitSub(new SubExpr(tree, node));
                case CalcModule.LMul: return VisitMul(new MulExpr(tree, node));
            }
        }
        return DefaultVisit(tree, node);
    }

    public TResult Visit<TView>(TView view) where TView : struct, ISyntaxView<TView> => Visit(view.Tree, view.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitProgram(ProgramNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitAssign(AssignNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitExprStatement(ExprStatementNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitNum(NumExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitRef(RefExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitCall(CallExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitParen(ParenExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitNeg(NegExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitAdd(AddExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitSub(SubExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitMul(MulExpr node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    protected virtual TResult DefaultVisit(SyntaxTree tree, int node) => default!;
}
